title: harmony_knn
description: Cell type annotation workflow by performing harmony integration of reference and query dataset followed by KNN label transfer.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: Input dataset consisting of the (unlabeled) query observations. The dataset is expected to be pre-processed in the same way as --reference.
input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['input.h5mu']`

modality.description: Which modality to process. Should match the modality of the --reference dataset.

input_layer.description: The layer of the input dataset to process if .X is not to be used. Should contain log normalized counts.

input_obs_batch_label.description: The .obs field in the input (query) dataset containing the batch labels.

input_var_gene_names.description: The .var field in the input (query) dataset containing gene names; if not provided, the .var index will be used.

input_reference_gene_overlap.description: The minimum number of genes present in both the reference and query datasets.

overwrite_existing_key.description: If provided, will overwrite existing fields in the input dataset when data are copied during the reference alignment process.

reference.description: Reference dataset consisting of the labeled observations to train the KNN classifier on. The dataset is expected to be pre-processed in the same way as the --input query dataset.
reference.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['reference.h5mu']`

reference_layer.description: The layer of the reference dataset to process if .X is not to be used. Should contain log normalized counts.

reference_obs_target.description: The `.obs` key of the target cell type labels to transfer.

reference_var_gene_names.description: The .var field in the reference dataset containing gene names; if not provided, the .var index will be used.

reference_obs_batch_label.description: The .obs field in the reference dataset containing the batch labels.

n_hvg.description: Number of highly variable genes to subset for.

pca_num_components.description: Number of principal components to compute. Defaults to 50, or 1 - minimum dimension size of selected representation.

harmony_theta.description: Diversity clustering penalty parameter. Can be set as a single value for all batch observations or as multiple values, one for each observation in the batches defined by --input_obs_batch_label. theta=0 does not encourage any diversity. Larger values of theta result in more diverse clusters."

leiden_resolution.description: Control the coarseness of the clustering. Higher values lead to more clusters.

knn_weights.description:
Weight function used in prediction. Possible values are:
`uniform` (all points in each neighborhood are weighted equally) or 
`distance` (weight points by the inverse of their distance)

knn_n_neighbors.description:
The number of neighbors to use in k-neighbor graph structure used for fast approximate nearest neighbor search with PyNNDescent. 
Larger values will result in more accurate search results at the cost of computation time.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['output.h5mu']`

output_obs_predictions.description:
In which `.obs` slots to store the predicted cell labels.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_pred"` suffix.

output_obs_probability.description:
In which `.obs` slots to store the probability of the predictions.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_probability"` suffix.

output_obsm_integrated.description: In which .obsm slot to store the integrated embedding.

output_compression.description: The compression format to be used on the output h5mu object.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
